# FLX-3606: a consumer view is malformed, repeated or named like an expose

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A view is a mapping of a name and the SQL it stands for. Its name follows the grammar of a query id, is unique among the views and is not the exposeId of an emit, since a query that read that name could not tell the view from the table. At most 256 views are declared.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3606
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
